item.title: 'Huna' writer wins National Book Award for non-fiction, after not being allowed into the U.S.
item.description:
【AI 精简版】 AI-condensed version. This text was produced by an LLM from the original article and may omit details. The original link at the end is the only authoritative source.

Why it is here: original reporting, evidence and concrete detail

Abdelrahman ElGendy won the National Book Award for non-fiction for 'Huna,' a memoir of his time as a political prisoner in Egypt. His visa to the U.S. was denied, but eligibility criteria were expanded. Editor Helen Thomaides accepted the award. Hannah Lilith Assadi won the Fiction award for 'Paradiso 17.' Brenda Hillman won Poetry for 'Still House in the Desert.' Vicente Luis Mora and Rahul Bery won Translated Literature for 'Centroeuropa.' David Levithan and Gabriel Duckels won Young People's Literature for 'The Fight of Our Lives.' Perri Klass and Salman Rushdie received lifetime achievement awards. Kyle MacLachlan hosted.

Source: NPR Books | Published: 2026-11-19 06:13 UTC

Original link: https://www.npr.org/2026/11/19/nx-s1-6037553/huna-writer-wins-national-book-award-for-non-fiction-after-not-being-allowed-into-the-u-s

item.title: Hannah Lillith Assadi wins US National book award for ‘visionary’ novel Paradiso 17
item.description:
【AI 精简版】 AI-condensed version. This text was produced by an LLM from the original article and may omit details. The original link at the end is the only authoritative source.

Why it is here: original reporting, evidence and concrete detail

Palestinian-Jewish author Hannah Lillith Assadi wins US National Book Award for 'visionary' novel Paradiso 17. Assadi's novel explores displacement, inspired by her father's experience during the Nakba. Judges praised her 'elegant lyricism' and 'bending of time and space'. Assadi won $10,000 prize. Egyptian author Abdelrahman ElGendy won nonfiction prize for 'Huna: A Memoir of Revolution, Prison, and Becoming'. Syrian Samar Yazbek and others were denied visas. Publishers submitted 1,912 books.

Source: The Guardian Books | Published: 2026-11-19 04:54 UTC
